pages.title: Point-Defense Turrets
pages.text: Point-defense turrets specialize in attacking entities and intercepting projectiles.$(br2)Their high rate of fire makes them more effective against mobs than ordinary turrets, but they consume ammunition very quickly.$(br2)They cannot attack hostile subspaces. Their fourth targeting option is replaced by Defense mode.$(br2)In Defense mode, they target and fire at projectiles within range that are traveling toward their own subspace.
Point-defense turrets ignore projectiles launched from their own subspace, preventing them from intercepting friendly fire.
